analysis.missing_data: no verdict for an incomplete model-mode configuration
analysis.regime_pairs: all regime-recognise pairs across three repetitions
analysis.template_gate: a cluster is usable if any template meets both inside/given thresholds
analysis.template_primary: average ALL templates within cluster, then equal cluster weights; usability only gates the verdict
analysis.template_usable_only: descriptive sensitivity analysis; never used for D-1
analysis.textbook_ci: average repetitions within trap, independently resample traps within family
analysis.textbook_gate_parent_denominator: unique parent ids, averaged over all three repetitions

notes: All 72 templates retained as D prescribes; physical caveats in PROPOSAL still apply.
No pooled cross-family verdict; no detected effect is not evidence of equivalence.
